name: Node by Term
description: Admin tool to filter and list nodes by vocabulary, taxonomy term and content type.
project_description:
With the help of this module we can fetch all our nodes on the basis of taxonomy term and vocablary and content type. 
 Features 
 The main Features of this module is the you can filter all published node which is using vocabulary and taxonomy term and when you select vocabulary it will load the taxonomy term then we can filter our nodes on the basis of it also you can filter node by content type .

 Post-Installation 
 After Installation , You will get one message "Go to nodelist" by clicking it you will go to that page "/nodelist". 

 Additional Requirements 
 Does this project need anything beyond Drupal core? Include any dependent modules, libraries, APIs, etc., that are required for this project to work.

 Supporting this Module 
 If you have lots of nodes and taxonomy term in your project you can use this module that will filter all nodes on your Requirements.
